title: DGFT Mandates Import Licensing for 4 Specific Silver Categories
summary: Restricts silver powder, grains, and 99.9% silver imports to valid DGFT authorization.

blocks.content: Restricts silver powder, grains, and 99.9% silver imports to valid DGFT authorization.

items: Silver Restriction: Requires DGFT Import Authorisation for silver powder (71061000), silver grains (71069110), 99.9% silver (71069120), and other silver (71069190).
Nominated Agencies: RBI and DGFT notified agencies, as well as IFSCA-notified jewellers on IIBX, must secure DGFT licences.
Forex Conservation: Designed to curb excessive silver imports and reduce trade deficit pressure.
